facts.value: Functional Foods and Product Development - MSc

metadata.chunk_title: Programme Information

facts.value: Gain the expertise to work in the food, beverage and pharmaceutical industries with UL’s Master of Science in Functional Foods and Product Development. Pursue a career in food science and technology, food chemistry or nutrition with UL’s innovative Master of Science (MSc) in Functional Foods and Product Development.

metadata.chunk_title: Programme Information

facts.value: The wide range of modules prepares students to design in vitro (i.e. chemical and cell-based protocols) and in vivo (i.e. yeasts, animals, and human interventions) protocols.

metadata.chunk_title: Programme Information

facts.value: There is an exit route for students after completion of the taught modules. Students who exit after the autumn and spring semesters will earn a Postgraduate Certificate and Postgraduate Diploma, respectively. Students who continue onto the summer semester will be awarded an MSc.

metadata.chunk_title: Programme Information

value.value: Gain hands-on practical experience in developing foods and ingredients.
Explore the theoretical and practical science and technologies behind the development and validation of functional foods.
Focus on EFSA regulations on Novel Foods and Health claims as well as project management, innovation, business and entrepreneurship.

metadata.chunk_title: Programme Information

facts.value: Explore a wide range of topics including sensory analysis, product development, fermentation-based products, functional lipids and protein-based ingredients, nutraceuticals and epidemiology.

facts.value: The Faculty of Arts, Humanities and Social Sciences (AHSS) is a dynamic community where ideas are explored, challenged, and brought to life. It offers high-quality teaching and a rich research environment that spans traditional disciplines and innovative interdisciplinary work.

metadata.chunk_title: Programme Information

facts.value: The Education and Health Sciences (EHS) Faculty includes the Schools of Medicine, Allied Health, Education, and Nursing and Midwifery as well as the Departments of Psychology, Physical Education and Sport Sciences. The faculty has built a reputation for high-quality teaching and innovative academic programmes. It works hard to prepare excellent scientists and caring, competent health professionals.

metadata.chunk_title: Programme Information

facts.value: The Kemmy Business School (KBS) is a dynamic, innovative business school with a reputation, established over 30 years, for delivering a first-class business education that prepares graduates for successful, rewarding careers across a wide range of business disciplines and professions.

metadata.chunk_title: Programme Information

facts.value: The Faculty of Science and Engineering is well recognised for the quality of its teaching and learning, academic programmes and research expertise. It has three world-class research institutes in Materials and Surface Sciences, Software Engineering and Mathematics, all underpinned by well-established industry links.

metadata.chunk_title: Programme Information

facts.value: The Irish World Academy of Music and Dance is the centre of academic and performance excellence at University of Limerick, Ireland. It honours the energies of performance and academic reflection across a wide range of genres and disciplines. These are informed by community outreach and artist-in-residence initiatives that take the Academy to the wider community, attracting international performance and scholarly expertise.
Located on the west coast of Ireland along the picturesque River Shannon and enjoys an unspoiled natural environment blended with state-of-the-art teaching and research facilities.
This setting blends lush parkland, riverside walkways, and wildlife with modern learning spaces, creating a peaceful yet inspiring environment for students.
Voted number one in the world for student experience.
More than 100 taught postgraduate programmes to Doctoral and Post-doctoral level.
UL Global at the University of Limerick assists all international students coming to UL under our Postgraduate, Undergraduate, Study Abroad, Erasmus+, Exchange and Summer School programmes.
